method: Exploratory participant-paired single-step max-T analysis of all declared CNN-reference, within-decoder token-versus-feature, and between-decoder tokenization-gap contrasts in one family. Average three decoder seeds within each of nine participants. Standardize each mean paired difference by its sample standard error, then enumerate all 512 participant sign vectors, applying each participant sign synchronously to all contrasts. Recompute each t statistic and retain the largest absolute t per sign vector. Each adjusted p is the inclusive tail proportion of this maximum distribution beyond the observed absolute t; no additional Holm correction is applied. Finite-sample strong familywise error control requires independent participants and joint central sign symmetry of their true-null contrast vectors. Marginal symmetry alone is insufficient; these assumptions cannot be established with nine participants. Effects are alternative minus reference error in millimetres; negative favors the alternative. All four direct representation contrasts use tokens minus encoder features, so positive favors features. Gap contrasts subtract proposed's token-minus-feature gap from the other decoder's gap, so positive favors proposed. Exact 95% pointwise location intervals invert the univariate sign-flip test, assuming independent differences symmetric about a common effect, equal to the mean when finite. Intervals are not simultaneous and do not assign stars. All nine leave-one-participant-out mean differences describe influence. Histories, pretraining and some training protocols differ, so these compare fitted systems. The method was amended after earlier results were inspected and fixed before computing max-T outcomes; this is not preregistered confirmation. The previous global Holm analysis is retained as sensitivity output. Non-rejection does not establish equivalence.

comparison_protocol.reason: User requested a better analysis after the exact paired test plus global Holm correction had inadequate resolution for the declared family.
comparison_protocol.scope: Exploratory method amendment after prior results and the Holm limitation were inspected; not preregistered or independent confirmation. Method fixed before computing new max-T outcomes.
comparison_protocol.family: One joint family: 44 CNN-reference contrasts, four within-decoder token-versus-feature contrasts, and three other-minus-proposed tokenization-gap contrasts.
comparison_protocol.method: Single-step exact synchronized participant sign-flip max-|t| test.
comparison_protocol.statistic: Per-contrast mean paired difference divided by its sample SD / sqrt(9). Recompute after each sign pattern.
comparison_protocol.randomization: Enumerate all 512 sign vectors. Flip each participant row synchronously across all 51 contrasts. Include identity and complete reversal; inclusive tails with floating-point tolerance. Do not center observed differences before flipping.
comparison_protocol.adjustment: For each sign vector retain the largest absolute t across all 51 contrasts. Adjusted p for each contrast is the proportion of these joint maxima at least as large as its observed absolute t. No extra Holm correction.
assumptions: Participants are independent analysis units; three seeds are averaged within each participant.

For finite-sample strong familywise error control, each participant true-null contrast vector is jointly centrally symmetric around zero under independent whole-row sign reversals. Marginal symmetry alone is insufficient.
For pointwise location confidence intervals, participant differences are independent and symmetric about a common effect (equal to the mean when it exists).
These distributional assumptions cannot be established from nine participants. Inference is exploratory and conditional on the studied data/protocol and shared frozen representation.
comparison_protocol.effect_direction: Alternative minus reference error (mm); for CNN comparisons negative favors the alternative. All four representation contrasts use tokens minus encoder features; positive favors features. Gap contrasts subtract the proposed signed token-minus-feature gap from each other decoder gap; positive favors proposed.
comparison_protocol.intervals: 95% pointwise exact sign-flip location intervals obtained by inversion of the univariate two-sided test. Not simultaneous; not used to assign significance stars.
comparison_protocol.sensitivity: Report all nine leave-one-participant-out mean differences and their range. Retain the previous global Holm results as sensitivity output; no method selection by result count.
comparison_protocol.no_pseudoreplication: Do not count 27 seeds or test frames as independent participants.
excluded: Old matched-CNN versus old L1/SWA-CNN comparison
Historical JNE aggregate with no matched participant data
Other comparisons between nonreference models beyond the four within-decoder representation contrasts and three declared other-minus-proposed gap contrasts
